Why: Fed rate hikes + tariff/trade war fears. ￼ 2026 (2nd term midterm): $QQQ was up ~21% by Sept, now ~+16.5% after its worst week since June (−4.5%). Chips are leading the drop ($MU $INTC both fell 5%+ Friday). 10-yr yield near 5% = rate pressure again. Pros: earnings growth is expected to stay strong, AI demand is real, and after the 2018 sell-off the S&P jumped ~29% in 2019. Cons: valuations are higher than 2018, yields are higher, tariff risk hasn't gone away, and Oct–Dec is exactly where 2018 fell apart. See graph below. Same setup, not a guaranteed same ending.
